title: Quality Gates Report
description: Output of scripts/validate/run_quality_gates.py (CORE-EEAT + CITE + AI-Slop), stored at memory/workspace/{task_id}/quality.json and consumed by scripts/pipeline/pre_publish_gate.py::check_quality_gates. REWRITTEN 2026-07-01: the previous schema described an aspirational v3.2 contract (overall_score/iteration/gates.pillar_100/format_fit) that run_quality_gates.py never implemented — total producer/consumer drift, silently unenforced because the runner writes via Path.write_text (the Write/Edit schema hook never fires) and only surfaced when a legitimate override_note Edit was hook-blocked. This schema now documents the REAL contract.

vetoes.description: Hard vetoes triggered; any entry blocks publish unless quality.json carries a justified override_note

combined_verdict.description: Worst-of aggregation across the three gates; pre_publish_gate blocks on FIX_REQUIRED/BLOCKED (or any hard veto) unless override_note is present

override_note.description: OPTIONAL operator override with mandatory justification. Sanctioned ONLY for independently re-verified false positives (e.g. C01 fired on bot-walled but real sources: CourtListener 202, SEL 403-to-bots). pre_publish_gate.check_quality_gates passes a blocking verdict/veto when this is present — the note is the audit trail. Never use it to ship an unverified claim.
